summary.text: Doyle Heffley is the Republican incumbent, in office since December 1, 2010, seeking re-election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 122, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as trucking consultant.

paragraphs.text: Doyle Heffley earned an associate degree in architectural design and drafting from Lincoln Technical Institute.

Ballotpedia says his professional experience includes working in the trucking industry since 1996 and in management positions before becoming a consultant to small businesses in that industry, and that he has been affiliated with the Carbon County Republican Committee.
Heffley assumed office on December 1, 2010, and chaired the Human Services Committee in the 2023-2024 session.
